The House

Cross the threshold of the everyday.

The road narrows, the trees close in, the gate opens on its own — and then the house. Eight bedrooms across two floors, four social spaces, and a wellness floor below. A lounge with a billiard table, a dance floor, a sound system wired through to the terrace, and sofas deep enough that nobody moves for hours.

It is a house built for a group that wants to be left alone. Families take it for the pool and the private shore; companies and closed parties take it for the space and the discretion. The grounds are fenced, one party answers for the stay, and what happens inside stays between the people who are there.

Citadela Resort is let to one party at a time — families, companies, weddings and school groups alike. The wellness floor, the bar and the dance floor are in the hands of whoever books the house. Pets are not permitted.

Image 1 of 4

Why Citadela

Taken whole, by one party.

I

The house answers only to you

Citadela Resort is never shared between parties. Gates close behind your cars, the grounds are fenced, and for the length of your stay the address belongs to your group alone — which is what makes it work equally for a family week and a closed celebration.

II

Wellness with no clock on it

A heated indoor pool held at 29 °C all year, a Finnish sauna, an infrared cabin and a whirlpool — none of them booked by the hour, none of them shared with strangers. Towels, sheets and sauna linen are laid out and included.

III

The reservoir, three hundred metres down

Rozdrojovice sits on the quiet western shore of Brněnská přehrada, nine kilometres from the centre of Brno. Beaches, forest paths and the water are a short walk from the gate; the city is close enough for dinner and far enough not to be heard.

Who takes the house

Built for a group, priced for a long one.

The villa is only ever let whole, so it makes sense for parties large enough to fill it and long enough to settle in. Five kinds of group come back to us; each has its own arrangement, and each can have the boats, boards and bikes waiting at the gate.

Two ways the house runs

Nothing about the house changes with who books it — how it is run does. Groups bringing minors are taken in supervised mode, agreed before arrival.

Standard

Everything open, nothing on a timetable: the wellness floor, the bar and the dance floor are yours for the length of the stay.

Supervised

For school trips, camps and training weeks. Agreed with the organiser in advance and written into the booking.

  • Named supervisors present for the whole stay
  • Pool and sauna run to an agreed timetable, not open access
  • Locked for the stay: Dance pole
  • Refundable deposit of CZK 30,000
Ask for a group offer

For companies

An away-day your finance department can file.

Team-building at Citadela is bought the way a company buys anything else: a written quote, an invoice with your registration number on it, and one supplier for the house, the catering and the activities. What arrives is a programme, not a pile of bookings to arrange.

One invoice, not eleven

Accommodation, activities and rentals go on a single tax document made out to your company. No employee pays anything on the day and no one collects receipts afterwards.

A quote before you commit

Send the dates and the headcount and a written offer follows, with the price broken down per night, per person and per activity, so it can go through approval unchanged.

The working week costs less

Weekends fill themselves; Sunday to Thursday does not. Hold your away-day midweek and the stay is cheaper for it, with the whole house still yours alone.

The programme is ours to run

Boats, paddleboards, scooters and bikes come from our own fleet and are ready at the gate. A chef can cook in the house, or a caterer delivers. Your team turns up and takes part.

How the paperwork works

  • A written quote follows within 24 hours of your enquiry.
  • Invoiced to the company, payable within 14 days of issue.
  • We need the company name, registration number and VAT number for the invoice.
  • A 30% deposit against a purchase order confirms the dates.
  • Group arrangements start at 2 nights and 15 guests.
  • The headcount can be adjusted up to 14 days before arrival at no charge.

The fleet

The lake, the forest and the road — all of it from the gate.

A boat on the reservoir, boards on flat morning water, scooters and electric bikes for the shoreline, and a car or a motorcycle for the day someone wants to go further. Everything is ours, everything is waiting when you arrive, and nothing has to be collected from town.

Motorboat

On the reservoir with the whole group aboard, or towing whoever wants to be towed. Skippered by us if nobody in the party holds a licence.

Paddleboards

Six boards with paddles and vests, carried down to the shore three hundred metres below the house. The water is flattest before eight.

Electric scooters

Unlocked from an app, as many as your group needs, for as long as you are here. Charged in the garage overnight.

Electric bikes

For the shoreline trails and the climb to Veveří Castle, which is a very different ride with a motor under you.

Motorcycles

A chopper and a touring machine, for the roads above the reservoir. Licence and deposit required.

Cars

Two cars on site for the run into Brno, the airport transfer, or the shop nobody planned for. Fuel is charged as used.

The longer you stay, the less each night costs

Outside the fixed packages the house is priced by the night, and a group that stays on pays less for it. Reductions apply to the accommodation and the per-guest supplement, and they combine.

CZK 14,167 per night for the whole villa

  • 5% off from 7 nights
  • 10% off from 10 nights
  • 15% off from 14 nights
  • 15% off when every night falls between Sunday and Thursday
  • Reductions combine, up to a maximum of 25%.

Send your dates and headcount and the exact figure comes back in writing — the table above is what it is built from.

Good to know

  • Refundable damage deposit of CZK 20,000.
  • A booking becomes binding once a 50% deposit is paid.
  • Municipal tourist tax of CZK 30 per adult, per night.
  • Arrival from 16:00, departure by 10:00.
  • In high season only full weeks are available, Sunday to Sunday.
  • Outside high season the length of stay is always open to discussion.
  • Please state the exact number of guests; there are 40 beds.
  • Parking is included.
  • Pets are not permitted.
  • Energy is billed after the stay; consumption is visible throughout. Water is included.
  • If the final tidy-up is not done, a fee of CZK 2,000 applies.

Cancellation

  • 10% of the total when cancelling 91 days or fewer before arrival
  • 50% of the total when cancelling 61 days or fewer before arrival
  • 70% of the total when cancelling 60 days or fewer before arrival
  • 100% of the total when cancelling 29 days or fewer before arrival

You may nominate a replacement party to take over the booking in full, in which case no cancellation fee applies.

Table

Cook, order in, or hand it over.

The kitchen is fully equipped and the coffee is on us. Outside there is a fire pit with a 50 × 100 cm grill grate, skewers, and a rotating spit big enough for a whole hog or lamb. A chef can cook for you in the house, or a caterer can deliver.

Location

Nine kilometres, another world.

Za Humny 262 sits in a quiet corner of Rozdrojovice on the western shore of the Brno reservoir. The road is good and passable all year, and there is room for eight cars behind the gate.

  • Reservoir shore300 m
  • Restaurants800 m
  • Brno city centre9 km

  • Penny & Lidl4 km

Open in maps

Water, forest, and the city when you want it.
Walks straight from the gate, cycling along the reservoir, beaches for swimming and sunbathing, and a wellness resort nearby for treatments. Veveří Castle and the Podkomorské lesy nature park are within an afternoon's ride, and Brno is close enough for a concert or an exhibition.
